preferred_stock_overhang.conversion_mechanics: Holder Optional Conversion settles at (Stated Value $25.00 + accrued dividends - conversion fee) divided by the 5-DAY VWAP of the common. THE CONVERSION RATIO IS FLOORLESS: the lower the common price, the more shares issued. Right terminates on exchange listing.
preferred_stock_overhang.FINDING: 541,007,217 common shares are RESERVED for preferred conversion against 488,029,036 common shares outstanding - a potential dilution of MORE THAN 110% of the existing common base. Diluted weighted-average share count in the EPS note is 929,940,155 vs 483,414,178 basic. The convertible preferred liquidation preference ($1,289,228) EXCEEDS the entire common market capitalization (488,029,036 x $2.61 = $1,273,756).

sources_of_nine_month_issuance.ATM_or_public_offering: NONE in the period - no common equity offering line appears in the Statements of Changes in Net Assets.

share_count_growth_and_dilution.FINDING: All new common was issued at $2.66-$2.87 per share against a NAV of $6.05-$6.56 - i.e. at roughly 44% of NAV. Issuing 32.1M shares for $90,686 of net assets, versus $202,395 had they been issued at NAV, transfers ~$111,709 of net assets away from existing common = ~$0.23/share, which reconciles to the disclosed 'Common stock transactions' drag of -$0.25/share over nine months. Pace is ACCELERATING: +12,978,617 shares in the five weeks between 3/31/2026 and 5/6/2026.
share_count_growth_and_dilution.MECHANISM: This is self-reinforcing: preferred converts at the 5-day VWAP, so a lower common price mints more shares, which dilutes NAV/share further. Nothing in the instrument arrests it short of an exchange listing of the preferred or redemption.

fee_mechanics.base_management_fee: 2.00% per annum on TOTAL (GROSS) ASSETS, including assets financed with leverage - not on net assets. Q3 FY26 fee $32,304; 9mo $98,853.
fee_mechanics.income_incentive_fee: Quarterly, hurdle 1.75%/qtr (7.00% annualized) on NET ASSETS; 100% catch-up between the hurdle and 125% of the hurdle; 20% above that. Q3 FY26 $2,300; 9mo $19,569.
fee_mechanics.PIK_IN_THE_FEE_BASE: CONFIRMED, verbatim from Note 13: 'Pre-incentive fee net investment income includes, in the case of investments with a deferred interest feature (such as original issue discount, debt instruments with PAYMENT-IN-KIND interest and zero coupon securities), ACCRUED INCOME THAT WE HAVE NOT YET RECEIVED IN CASH.' Non-cash PIK income therefore generates a cash fee to the adviser.
fee_mechanics.lookback: The income incentive fee has NO total-return lookback and NO capital-loss offset. The separate capital gains incentive fee (20%, annual, since-inception netting of realized gains against realized losses and unrealized depreciation) is a distinct calculation; none was incurred in 9mo FY26 or 9mo FY25.
fee_mechanics.ALIGNMENT_NOTE: Base fee on gross assets rewards leverage; income incentive fee on PIK-inclusive NII with no loss lookback rewards accruing non-cash income. Both are structurally biased toward holding assets at accrual rather than writing them down.

realization_washout.FINDING: The entire 2.54-point improvement in FV/cost (+$163,211 swing in the net unrealized position) was accompanied by $530,786 of REALIZED losses in the same twelve months - $3.25 of realized loss for every $1 of unrealized 'improvement'. Portfolio amortized cost fell from $6,955,011 to $6,192,901 (-$762,110) as impaired basis left the book. The FV/cost improvement is substantially a SURVIVORSHIP/WASHOUT artifact of realizing losses and resetting cost basis, not evidence of credit improvement.
realization_washout.note: PSEC does NOT separately disclose the reversal-of-prior-period-unrealized component of net change in unrealized. Searched for 'reversal of unrealized', 'reclassification of unrealized' - not present. The washout share cannot be measured exactly from the filing; see coverage_gaps.

coverage_gaps: INTERNAL RISK RATINGS: not disclosed at all in PSEC's 10-Q. No rating scale, no bucket distribution, no migration table. Searched 'risk rating', 'internal rating', 'investment rating', 'watch list', 'credit quality', 'Rating 1'. PSEC's only 'Credit Quality Indicators' note covers rate mix, non-accruals and undrawn commitments. Item 5 of the spec is UNANSWERABLE from this filing.

REALIZATION-WASHOUT SPLIT: the filing does not disclose how much of 'net change in unrealized gains (losses)' is the REVERSAL of previously-recorded unrealized losses on positions realized during the period versus genuine mark movement on retained positions. Searched 'reversal of unrealized', 'reclassification of unrealized', 'reversal of net unrealized' - absent. The $3.25-realized-per-$1-unrealized ratio is reported as circumstantial evidence, not as a measured washout share.

Q4 FY25 (quarter ended 2025-06-30) FIGURES ARE DERIVED, NOT DIRECTLY DISCLOSED: computed as FY2025 10-K full-year minus the nine months ended 2025-03-31. This applies to that quarter's total investment income, PIK, NII, preferred dividends, realized and unrealized. PSEC files no Q4 10-Q. The Q4 FY25 weighted-average share count (~452.4M) is an approximation derived from annual and nine-month weighted averages and is NOT additive-exact; the Q4 FY25 per-share figures inherit that approximation.

PIK BY ISSUER: the filing discloses PIK interest income only in aggregate and split by control/non-control. It does NOT disclose PIK dollars by portfolio company, so PIK cannot be attributed to the specific marks it supports. The SOI does carry a per-tranche PIK RATE column, but rates are not dollars and were not converted.

PIK DIVIDEND INCOME: PSEC's income statement separates 'PIK interest income' but does not state how much of DIVIDEND income is paid in kind versus cash. Note 2 confirms PIK dividends exist as a category ('PIK interest or dividends'). The $6,349 (Q3) / $24,264 (9mo) of controlled-affiliate dividend income therefore cannot be split cash-vs-PIK from this filing. Treated as a flag, not a quantified PIK figure.

TOP-20 PAR: 'par' for each top-20 borrower is the sum of DEBT-tranche principal only. PSEC's SOI reports a single ragged column set where equity tranches carry share/unit counts in the same position; those are excluded rather than summed into par. fv_pct_of_par is therefore computed over the debt tranches only and is NOT meaningful for borrowers whose value sits mostly in equity (notably National Property REIT Corp., First Tower Finance Company LLC and Valley Electric Company, Inc.). fv_pct_of_cost is the reliable comparator and is provided alongside.

TRAILING-4-QUARTER DISTRIBUTION TOTAL IN DOLLARS: per-share declared rates are exact from the Note 9 table; the Q4 FY25 dollar distribution total was not extracted (only the nine-month FY26 total of $191,708 and nine-month FY25 total of $202,878 are disclosed).
The ViaPath/Aventiv corporate relationship noted in structural_notes is NOT stated in the filing and is flagged as an observation requiring independent confirmation.
MARKET PRICE: the $2.61 close is the 3/31/2026 figure disclosed in Note 16. No live/current market price was pulled - this extraction is filing-only per the brief.
